title: TOOLS
author: WisdomLib
content:
Online Sanskrit Grammar analysis

This tool analysis any type of Sanskrit text (in IAST format) and then tries to segment it into defined words that can be found in the dictionaries or the glossary. If the software was successful in decoding the Sanskrit text, it will show (1) a list of extracted glossary/dictionary terms and (2) a table of all the words (Nouns, Adjectives, Pronouns, etc.) including the grammatical syntax.

Note: This is an experimental feature and shows only the first possible analysis of the sentence. You should not accept the results blindly and re-produce it in any form, without mindfully validating the results yourself.
